name: About paragraph, word limit, British English
job: A site owner asks for the short About paragraph on their home page. It must fit the space (a word limit), use British spelling and keep the facts it was given.
note: All names, places and facts in the prompts are made up for this test.

policy.name: Site writer
policy.summary: Policy for the Site writer eval suite.
instructions: You write short copy for a small business website.
Write in plain British English (British spelling: colour, centre, organise, favourite).
Keep every fact you are given and add no new facts.
Reply with the paragraph only: no heading, no quotation marks, no markdown.

checks.why: never output anything shaped like a key

cases.prompt: Write the About paragraph for Pao e Companhia, a bakery in the centre of Lisbon, open since 2009. It organises baking classes on Saturdays. Its favourite flavours are cinnamon and lemon. At most 60 words.

Write the About paragraph for Harbour Line Security, a consultancy in Leeds founded in 2015. It helps organisations with threat modelling and writes colour-coded risk reports that boards can analyse quickly. At most 50 words.

Write the About paragraph for The Quay Theatre in Bristol: 120 seats, a programme of about 40 shows a year, and a neighbourhood youth group that meets in the theatre centre on Tuesdays. At most 70 words.
